label: Telemetry ETL
info: Subscribes to +/+/+/telemetry, validates each payload, checks the asset against the registry, and inserts one sensor_readings row per signal that has an asset_limits row. On start, and until the database answers, it upserts assets and asset_limits from PROFILE_DIR. A failed lookup uses the catalog copy. A failed insert appends the accepted row to the spool and retries the same INSERT. A refused signal is published to the topic rejected and inserted into rejected_messages.

Look up asset

Record queue depth

INSERT INTO queue_depth (id, depth, updated_at)
VALUES (1, $1, now())

name: Build registry upsert
Upsert registry
query:
WITH incoming AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS p(
        asset_id text,
        plant text,
        area text,
        asset_type text,
        criticality text,
        signals jsonb
    )
),
upsert_asset AS (
    INSERT INTO assets (asset_id, plant, area, asset_type, criticality)
    SELECT asset_id, plant, area, asset_type, criticality
    FROM incoming
    ON CONFLICT (asset_id) DO UPDATE SET
        plant = EXCLUDED.plant,
        area = EXCLUDED.area,
        asset_type = EXCLUDED.asset_type,
        criticality = EXCLUDED.criticality
    RETURNING asset_id
)
INSERT INTO asset_limits (
    asset_id, signal, unit, nominal,
    alarm_low, warning_low, warning_high, alarm_high, reference
)
SELECT i.asset_id, s.name, s.unit, s.nominal,
       s.alarm_low, s.warning_low, s.warning_high, s.alarm_high, s.reference
FROM incoming i
JOIN upsert_asset a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(i.signals) AS s(
    name text,
    unit text,
    nominal double precision,
    alarm_low double precision,
    warning_low double precision,
    warning_high double precision,
    alarm_high double precision,
    reference text
)
ON CONFLICT (asset_id, signal) DO UPDATE SET
    unit = EXCLUDED.unit,
    nominal = EXCLUDED.nominal,
    alarm_low = EXCLUDED.alarm_low,
    warning_low = EXCLUDED.warning_low,
    warning_high = EXCLUDED.warning_high,
    alarm_high = EXCLUDED.alarm_high,
    reference = EXCLUDED.reference

name: Prune limits
query:
DELETE FROM asset_limits AS existing
WHERE existing.asset_id IN (
    SELECT p.asset_id
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS p(asset_id text)
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS p(asset_id text, signals jsonb)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(p.signals) AS s(name text)
    WHERE p.asset_id = existing.asset_id
      AND s.name = existing.signal
)
